metaDescription: MIW is a team of seven in Prague: engineers, an analyst and a designer. Who we are, what we do and how we work.
title: A small team that finishes what it starts.
lede: Seven people in Prague. We build for small businesses and startups, and we build our own products — so we know what it takes to get from an idea to people using it.

items.label: For small businesses
items.body: Websites, online stores, booking, and simple systems for stock and orders.

items.label: For startups
items.body: MVPs, backends and AI features, from the first version onwards.

team.title: The team
team.lede: You talk directly to the people who build your project.

roles.ivan: IT analyst · system design, UML, BPMN, Spring Boot

items.label: Plain language
items.body: You understand what you pay for, and why.

items.label: Finished, not demoed
items.body: We judge work by what people can actually use.

items.label: Straight about status
items.body: What is done, what is not, and what we are not sure about yet.

cta.title: Let's build something useful
cta.body: Tell us what you need in a few lines. A person from the team replies.
